zh.text: 启动器自更新的验签公钥落地：更新包必须带维护者私钥签名才认。0.2.0 那版没配公钥、验不了签，自更新从这一版起才真正可用
界面多语言：中文、英语、日语、韩语、法语、德语、荷兰语、俄语共 8 种，默认跟随系统语言（认不出来用英语）；外壳文案七种外语各 61 条，英语为全量目录
账号卡片底部不再画「上次登录 / 建于」（后端账号接口本来就不返回这两项，一直是「—」），改成该账号三个角色钱包余额的 ISK 合计
角色卡片右上角显示军团与联盟徽标，鼠标悬停给出军团 / 联盟名（图来自本地图片服务，端口跟随配置中心）
修复新建角色一直显示「种族资料未记录」：种族 / 血统 / 性别改从服务端角色表读出（raceID / bloodlineID / gender 换算），服务端确实没记录的才留空
角色卡片底部把「建于 —」换成角色所在星系，「进入游戏」下面一眼能看到人在哪个星系
模组发布改为每一版都提审核 PR：首次含 sources.json 收录登记，之后每次更新提 mods/<id>.json 分片；维护者合并后索引 CI 立刻重建，市场才换到新版本（之前只有第一次发布才提 PR）
提交模组后自动复查那条审核 PR（首次提交 / 版本更新 / 审核中再更新都会查）：卡片上显示 PR 编号与「审核中 / 已合并 / PR 已关闭」；同一模组两次提交至少间隔 30 分钟，PR 状态复查同样 30 分钟节流

en.text: The launcher's own update signature key is now in place: update packages must be signed with the maintainer key. 0.2.0 shipped without the public key, so self-update only really works from this version on

UI localisation: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Dutch and Russian - eight languages, defaulting to the system language (English when unrecognised). The shell has 61 strings in each of the seven foreign languages, with English as the full catalogue
The account card footer no longer shows "Last login / Built" (the backend never returned either, so both were always "—"); it now shows the combined ISK balance of the account's three characters
Character cards show the corporation and alliance logo in the top-right corner, with the name on hover (images come from the local image service; the port follows the config)

Fixed newly created characters always showing "Race data not recorded": race, bloodline and gender are now read from the server's character table (raceID / bloodlineID / gender) and only left blank when the server really has no record
The character card footer replaced "Built —" with the character's solar system, so the system is visible right below "Enter game"

Every mod release now opens a review PR: the first one carries the sources.json registration, later ones submit a mods/<id>.json shard; the maintainer merging it rebuilds the index CI and only then does the market move to the new version (previously only a first publish opened a PR)

After submitting a mod the launcher re-checks that review PR (first submission, version update and re-update while in review all get checked): the card shows the PR number plus "In review / Merged / PR closed". Two submissions of the same mod must be at least 30 minutes apart, and the PR re-check is throttled to 30 minutes as well
